cases.what_created: Kelly Air Mail Act moved US air mail to private carriers and started the commercial airline industry.
cases.source: Air Mail Act of 1925 (Kelly Act), 43 Stat. 805.

cases.what_created: Air Commerce Act: federal licensing of pilots and aircraft and airway markings.
Crash of TWA Flight 6 killed US Senator Bronson Cutting and led to a Senate investigation.
cases.source: Komons, N., Bonfires to Beacons: Federal Civil Aviation Policy under the Air Commerce Act, 1926-1938 (1978).

cases.what_created: Civil Aeronautics Act created a federal authority for airline safety, routes and accident investigation.
Mid-air collision over the Grand Canyon killed 128 people.
cases.source: FAA history, 'A Brief History of the FAA'; Civil Aeronautics Board accident report (1957).

cases.what_created: Federal Aviation Act created the Federal Aviation Agency to run air traffic control and safety rules.
cases.source: Federal Aviation Act of 1958, Public Law 85-726.

cases.what_created: Tenerife runway collision of two 747s killed 583 people, the deadliest accident in aviation history.
cases.source: Spanish Ministry of Transport and Communications, Report on the Tenerife accident (1978).

cases.what_created: Airline Deregulation Act opened fares and routes to competition.
cases.source: Airline Deregulation Act of 1978, Public Law 95-504.

cases.what_created: Airlines adopted crew resource management training after accidents caused by poor cockpit teamwork.
cases.source: NASA workshop 'Resource Management on the Flightdeck' (1979); United Airlines first CRM program (1981). Adoption date is approximate.

cases.what_created: September 11 attacks used four hijacked airliners.
cases.source: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States, The 9/11 Commission Report (2004).

cases.what_created: Aviation and Transportation Security Act created the Transportation Security Administration.
cases.source: Aviation and Transportation Security Act, Public Law 107-71 (November 2001).

cases.what_created: Colgan Air Flight 3407 crash near Buffalo killed 50 people and exposed pilot training and fatigue gaps.
Airline Safety and Federal Aviation Administration Extension Act raised pilot qualification and training standards.
Boeing 737 MAX crashes (Lion Air 610, Ethiopian 302) killed 346 people.
cases.source: NTSB, 'Assumptions Used in the Safety Assessment Process and the Effects of Multiple Alerts and Indications on Pilot Performance' (2019).

cases.what_created: Worldwide grounding of the 737 MAX fleet.
cases.source: FAA emergency order of prohibition, March 13, 2019.

cases.what_created: Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act reformed FAA certification oversight.
cases.source: Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, Division R of Public Law 116-260 (December 2020).
